## Overview

NEWRAD 2026 is the premier international conference on optical radiometry. It directly covers spectral radiance, irradiance, emissivity measurement, blackbody calibration, and detector-based radiometry. Speakers from NPL, PTB, NIST, NRC, CNAM, and INMETRO.
